I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer from the shop, and the voucher program is not reaching our village this year. But I have collected cow manure from my animals during the dry season, which I will spread on this maize plot before planting. I will plant the seed I saved from last year's harvest because it is what I have, and I know it can grow here even when the rains are not good. My wife and children will help me with the land preparation, planting, weeding, and harvesting on this plot, as we always do with our hands and hoes.
